chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Mikueas gu Morasti gu tanoolh gu Jotam gu Akâs gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix ñi' bhaan gu Samaria gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨx; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan dɨr jix bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't ñi'ookdham bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios pai' jix dhaav bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p vupui bhaan gu tai na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Jakob uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu Jakob cham gu Samaria gu Judaa cham gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria gu maa'nkar gu oidha' oidha' u'va; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx juana' ka't gu tai bɨx duiñxim; na gu' juana' jum daa'ñ juana' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim jix duñia' tɨbiaptuda; gio ba' na ja'p gu u'uuv.
Na gu' na gu' tu jiim gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Judaa; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gat tu' jix jai'; gio ba' oo' gu Bet-le-apra.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx xi'ɨraam gu ñi'ook gu Sapir; gio ba' gu Saanaan cham jix buus gu ñi'ook gu Bet-esel; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Marot jix duñia' xoi'kam; na gu' cham bhai' jix dhaav gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Lakîs bɨɨpɨ' uañi'ñ mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; na gu' tu' gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maa'n juana' gu Moreset-gat; gio ba' gu vaak gu Aksib ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bi'ya' gu ñi'ook gu Maresa; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel ɨlhdham bɨɨx ka'm gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' Cham na pai' dhuuk jupaabkamu'n gu xibh jix duñia' na gu' namki' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨppɨr; gio ba' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bhaan dhi' ja'tkam vaak cham bhai' cham jix buusñi baakux tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oi'ñga'n vaas vaak ja'tkam jix maa.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' xi'ɨraam.
Na tu' tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios buimɨi gu ñi'ook cham xoi'kam gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Na gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' na ja'p bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' gu vaak; gio ba' a'aalh bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; na gu' jix duñia' jix gɨ' ja'bsuna'.
Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' suudai' u'va; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duñia' ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tɨɨda' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ju'ñdharan na ja'p kakneer gu Bosra na ja'p kakneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix duu gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan mo'o gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Dije; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' chiñia' gu Jakob ɨɨbhidham gu vaak gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maachim gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' cham bhai' zel gu chuukug bhaan o'oo.
Na kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu ja'tkam zel bhaan o'oo na ja'p na ba' na ja'p gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham; na gu' va'k gu ñi'ook gu vupui mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan xoi'kam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx taatam duuñ bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham bhaan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu tukaa' gu tukgam jix duñia'; gio ba' bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tas gu tanoolh bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' jix bhuup gu kavɨk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu kavɨk na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob uañi'ñ gu Israeel uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' dhi' ɨɨbhidham gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu Jerusalem bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan u'uuk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tuumiñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr cham gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham ɨlhdham cham bhai' bhaan no'ch.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha ka't gu Sioon na ja'p yooxi' gu Jerusalem ka't gu kavɨk gu vaak na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu Akontekeraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu kakkavɨk jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' aajim mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Sioon ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'x gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim u'uux na ba' u'u kavɨk na ba'; mi' dhɨr cham gu kuchii gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n iigɨx cham; na gu' gu chin gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sioon dɨr jano' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak kakneer gu kavɨk mar u'vɨ gu Sioon ɨlhdham bɨɨx ka'm tu'; gio ba' aapi' maa'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ɨlhdham mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu Perekioo tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Sioon na ja'p gu u'vɨ; na gu' jano' kiicham yooxi' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Babiloonia; mi' dhɨr ka' tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Sioon.
Gu' gu' cham jix maati' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' aagɨt; gio ba' jum daa'ñ na ja'p ka't.
Na gu' bamii' jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu Sioon na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' mui'x gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios namkɨm gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bhaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Bet-leem gu Eprata gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa tu' ka't gu Jawatan gu Israeel; gio ba' dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam dɨr gu tanoolh.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook kiicha' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'; na gu' jano' ka't bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu Assur daraibu' gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk oi'ñga'n jano' ba' bhaan kɨɨv bipia'dam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jugi gu oidha' gu Assur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Nimrod bɨɨx u'uux; na pai' dhuuk gu Asirio na pai' dhuuk daraibu' bhaan pai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'x gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p bhaan gu vaas cham gu chio'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jakob tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'x gu ja'tkam na ja'p maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu kavɨk na ja'p maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kooda' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio cham tu' duu jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx i'iich gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp cham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu kakkavɨk jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Responde bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Mariia.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Balak gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor dɨr gu Sittim bɨɨx ka'm gu Gilgal na ba' bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x bɨ'ñdhatu' maa'nkam mar uañi'ñ gu i'bhɨ vook uañi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' jiim bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duuñ kiicham jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨxi'ñdha' bɨɨx chu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx chutumñigam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook nɨɨn gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gio tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' jugi cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu' cham u'ua'tɨda'; jano' ba' dodhia' kapbhai' tu' gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' suudai' u'u gu' cham tu' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; mi' dhɨr gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Omri jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Akâb; gio ba' na ba' tu' koi gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ na ja'p na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' mi' dhɨr cham na ba' jugi; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix duu dharka' gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu oidha' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ xibhɨk.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx gu noobh gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix gɨ' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tutkɨ na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh jupaabkamu'n; jano' ba' jano' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix nukadham cham gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat mar u'vɨ jix búup bhaan gu naan bhaan bakxidhat; gio ba' obhɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'; na gu'; mi' dhɨr gu tukgam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bhaan bɨɨx ka'm kuiñcha ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xi'ɨraam; na chɨtda; mi' dhɨr duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui; jano' ba' jano' ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh aajim bɨɨx ka'm tu' dɨr gu Asiria jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk dɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Riio gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Karmelo; gio ba' gu Basaan gu Galaad na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p na ja'p gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu chin maatɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' oo' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu ko'oi gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ gu maa'nkar cham na ba' bɨɨx tas na gu' dha' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch no'ch; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob tu'r gu Abraam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' taata'n tattat dɨr.
